questions.question: If x% of 180 is 25% less than (x + 350), then 18% of (x + 50) is what percentage more than 12% of x?
The average of the 2-digit numbers 49, 6x, x4 and 70 is 65. What is the average of (x + 8) and (x + 12)?
questions.solution:
**Given**

The Average of the 2-digit numbers 49, 6x, x4, and 70 is 65

**Concept**

Average = sum of all observation/Number of observation

Two digit number is written in the form of 10x + y, where x is ten's digit and y is unit's digit.

**Calculation**

6x can be written as 6 × 10 + x

and x4 can be written as 10x + 4

so, two digit numbers are 49, (60 + x), (10x + 4) and 70

(49 + 60 + x + 10x + 4 + 70)/4 = 65

⇒ (183 + 11x)/4 = 65

⇒ 183 + 11x = 260

⇒ 11x = 260 - 183

⇒ 11x = 77

x = 7

(x + 8) = 7 + 8

⇒ 15

(x + 12) = 7 + 12

⇒ 19

Required average = (15 + 19)/2

⇒ 34/2

⇒ 17

**∴ The average of (x + 8) and (x + 12) is 17.**

questions.question: The amount obtained by investing a certain sum at r% p.a. for 3 years at simple interest is equal to the simple interest on the same sum at the same rate for 13 years. The value of r is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Amount (3 years) = Simple Interest (13 years)

Principal + SI (3 years) = SI (13 years)

Principal = SI (13 years) − SI (3 years) = SI (10 years)

For Principal (100%) to be equal to 10 years of interest, the annual rate must be 100% ÷ 10 = 10%.

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Principal = P, Rate = r% p.a., Time₁ = 3 years, Time₂ = 13 years.

Formula: Simple Interest (SI) = (P × r × t) / 100 | Amount (A) = P + SI.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e552677647a3c1a5a8ccc89628e0ec8f32a92be16f78caf004cf79d8fcf6f1a6.png] 

⇒ Amount after 3 years = P + (P × r × 3) / 100

⇒ Simple Interest for 13 years = (P × r × 13) / 100

⇒ According to the question: P + 3Pr/100 = 13Pr/100

⇒ P = 13Pr/100 − 3Pr/100

⇒ P = 10Pr/100

⇒ 1 = 10r/100

⇒ 1 = r/10

⇒ r = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Basics

Simple Interest is calculated only on the principal amount. The formula is SI = P × R × T / 100, where P is Principal, R is Rate, and T is Time.

Amount in Simple Interest

The total amount (A) at the end of the period is the sum of the principal and interest: A = P + SI = P(1 + RT/100).

Effective Rate of Interest

The effective interest earned over T years is (R × T)% of the principal. In this problem, the difference in time (13 − 3 = 10 years) represents the principal itself.</p

questions.question: The average of 18 numbers is 65. The average of the first 10 numbers is 72 and that of the last 9 numbers is 58. If the 10th number is excluded, then what is the average of the remaining numbers (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Average of 18 numbers is 65.

Average of the first 10 numbers is 72 

Average of the last 9 numbers is 58. 

**Concept**

Average = sum of all observation/Number of observation

**Calculation**

Sum of 18 numbers = 65 × 18

⇒ 1170

Sum of first 10 numbers = 72 × 10

⇒ 720

Sum of last 9 numbers = 9 × 58

⇒ 522

let the 10th number is x

sum of 18 numbers = sum of first 10 numbers + sum of last 9 numbers - value of 10th number

⇒ 1170 = 720 + 522 - x

⇒ 1170 = 1242 - x

⇒ x = 1242 - 1170

⇒ x = 72

Sum of remaining numbers = 1170 - 72

⇒ 1098

Remaining number = 17

Average of remaining number = 1098/17

⇒ 64.58 or 64.6

**∴ The average of the remaining numbers (correct to one decimal place) is 64.6**

questions.question: The ratio of A and B is 2 : 3, and B is 8 more than A. If a certain number k is added to each of A and B, then the ratio becomes 7 : 9. The value of k is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

Ratio of A and B is 2 : 3

 and B = A + 8

**Calculation**

A/B = 2/3

B = A + 8

⇒ A/(A + 8) = 2/3

⇒ 3A = 2A + 16

A = 16

B = 16 + 8

⇒ B = 24

k is added to A and B

A = 16 + k

B = 24 + k

(16 + k)/(24 + k) = 7/9

⇒ 9(16 + k) = 7(24 + k)

⇒ 144 +9k = 168 + 7k

⇒ 9k - 7k = 168 - 144

⇒ 2k = 24

⇒ k = 12

**∴ The value of k is 12**

questions.question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 8 hours and 12 hours, respectively. C is an outlet pipe. When all the three are opened together, the tank is filled in 13(1)/(3) hours. C alone can empty the full tank in:
questions.solution:
**Given**

Pipe A fills a tank in 8 hours

Pipe B fills a tank in 12 hours

**Concept**

Find the tank filled by A and B in one hour and tank empty by C in one hour.

**Calculation**

Let C alone takes x hours to empty the tank

Tank filled by A in 1 hour = 1/8

Tank filled by B in 1 hour = 1/12

Tank empty by C in 1 hour = 1/x

According to question

(1/8) + (1/12) - (1/x) = 3/40

⇒ (15 + 10 - 9)/120 = 1/x

⇒ (25 - 9)/120 = 1/x

⇒ 16/120 = 1/x

⇒ 120/16 = x

⇒ x = 7.5

**∴ C alone can empty the tank in 71over2 hours**

questions.question: A 270-m-long train takes 24 seconds to cross a pole. If it takes 1 minute to cross a tunnel, then the length (in m) of the tunnel is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

Train length = 270 m

Time = 24 seconds

**Formula used**

speed = distance/time

1 min = 60 seconds

**Calculation**

Speed of train = 270/24

⇒ 11.25 m/s

let the length of tunnel is x m

Total Distance travel by train = 270 + x

11.25 = (270 + x)/60

⇒ 675 = 270 + x

⇒ 675 - 270 = x

⇒ 405 = x

**∴ The length of the tunnel is 405 m**

questions.question:
What is the mean of the range and median of the given data?

11, 16, 14, 7, 11, 23, 10, 30, 20, 33, 19, 12, 17, 14
questions.solution:
**Given**

11, 16, 14, 7, 11, 23, 10, 30, 20, 33, 19, 12, 17, 14

**concept used**

To find the median, first arrange the given data in ascending or descending order

range = upper value - lower value

median = {(n/2)th term + [(n/2)th term + 1]}/2, where n is the number of observation respectively.

**calculation**

Arrange the data in ascending order = 7, 10, 11, 11, 12, 14, 14, 16, 17, 19, 20, 23, 30, 33

Range = 33 - 7

⇒ 26

median = {(14/2)th term + [(14/2) + 1]th term}/2 

⇒ (7th term + 8th term)/2

⇒ (14 + 16)/2

⇒ 30/2

⇒ 15

Mean = (26 + 15)/2

⇒ 41/2

⇒ 20.5

**∴ The mean of the range and median of the given data is 20.5**

questions.question: Let x be the smallest number between 70000 and 75000 which when divided by 225, 250 and 275 leaves remainder 61 in each case. Find the sum of the digits of x.
questions.solution:
**Given**

Two given numbers are 70,000 and 75,000

**Calculation**

L.C.M of 225, 250 and 275 is 24,750 i.e. (5 × 5 × 3 × 3 × 10 × 11)

If 24,750 is multiply by 2 then it will be 49,500 which is less than 70,000

if 24,750 is multiply by 3, then it will be 74250. it is between the 70,000 and 75,000

so, Required number will be 74250 + 61= 74,311

sum of the digits of x is 7 + 4 + 3 + 1 + 1 = 16

**∴ The sum of the digits of x is 16**

questions.question: A man covers a certain distance with a speed of 4(1)/(6)m/sec and comes back to the starting point with a speed of 12 km/h. Find his average speed (in km/h).
questions.solution:
**Given**

S₁ = 4(1)/(6) m/sec and S₂ = 12 km/h

**Concept used**

1 m/s = 18/5 km/h

Average speed = (2s₁s₂)/(s₁ + s₂)

**Calculation**

Speed = 4{1over6} m/s

⇒ 25over6 × 18over5km/h

⇒ 15 km/h

Average speed = (2 × 15 × 12)/(15 + 12)

⇒360/27 = 120/9 = 40/3 = 13(1)/(3)

**∴ Average speed (in km/h) is **13(1)/(3)** km/h**

questions.question: A shopkeeper marks an article 24% above its cost price and allows a 15% discount on the marked price. If he earns a profit of Rs. 27 by selling the article, then the selling price of the article is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

Market Price = cost price + 24% of cost price

Discount = 15%

**Formula used**

Selling price = Market Price - Discount

Profit = Selling price - Cost Price

when Selling price > Cost price

**Calculation**

Let the cost price is Rs.x

Market price = x + 24% of x

⇒ 124x/100

Discount = 15% of (124x/100)

⇒ 1860x/10000

Selling price = (124x/100) - (1860x/10000)

⇒ (12400x - 1860x)/10000

⇒ 10540x/10000

Profit = selling price - cost price

27 = (10540x/10000) - x

⇒ 27 = (10540x - 10000x)/10000

⇒ 27 = 540x/10000

x = (27 × 10000)/540

x = 500

Selling price = 500 + 27

⇒ Rs. 527

**∴ The selling price of the article is Rs.527**
